name: prax-screening
description: Counterparty and security screening for financial-services agents: banks and wires (BIC / IBAN / ABA / LEI), sanctions and US export controls, company verification (GLEIF, Companies House, EDGAR), adverse media, enforcement history, licence checks (MSB, BitLicense, MiCA, VARA, SFC, FCA), country risk, domains / e-mail / IPs, securities, vulnerabilities and software dependencies (OSV, CISA KEV, EPSS), wallets and transfers. Prax Data Services MCP plus a skill that screens every counterparty before you pay, sign, ship or onboard.
